This appeal coming on for admission this day, th e court  following:
 ORDER 1.

This appeal has been filed by the claimant against the award dated 01.09.2023 in MACC No.
1339/2022, whereby his claim for motor accident injury under 166 M.V. Act has been dismissed by Shubhendra Namdeo vs Raghunandan Upadhyay on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/85650232/
1

the learned 15 Additional MACT, Jabalpur on account of fact that learned tribunal has disbelieved the facts of claim petition specifically reason has been mentioned in paragraph numbers 13 to 15 and held that accident has not been proved, Specifically as reason of delay for four months in lodging the FIR has not been explained.

Learned counsel for the appellant very fairly submits that FIR was lodged belatedly for the simple reason that owner and driver of the offending vehicle has assured him that they will give all compensation and he need not complain to the police otherwise they will be ruined.

2. On perusal of the record and document, it is seen that in FIR Ex. P-2 in paragraph eight, cause of delay is only mentioned as report deri se darj karane ke karan but no cause has been mentioned that this delay was caused because owner and driver assured him that they will pay the compensation.
Report has been lodged on 03.02.2022 for the accident caused on 14.09.2021.
3.
It is not the case of the claimant that there was paralysis in his body.
In Ex. P/7 report of medical examination has been summoned by the police from medical college on 29.01.2022, whereas medical was conducted on 14.09.2022.
Shumendra Namdeo during the course of examination in the tribunal on 19.07.2023 has in paragraph 05 admitted that at the time of accident he had license but that has not been produced.
It is further admitted in paragraph number 7 of his statement Shri Shubendra has stopped that vehicle of the claimants was also damage but Police did not seize it.

In paragraph number 7 he further admitted that he does not know the person who has hit him, he does not know the number or colour of offending vehicle which caused the accident therefore, on a simple analysis of this fact that if the claimants was not knowing the name of the owner name and colour of the vehicle then how could any compromise talks were going on between parties is not proved.

Therefore, considering all the facts the tribunal has passed a reasonable award mentioning specific reason for dismissal of claim petition therefore, no interference can be made in the award dated 01.09.2003.
According, this appeal is dismissed at admission stage itself.
(AVANINDRA KUMAR SINGH) JUDGE R Shubhendra Namdeo vs Raghunandan Upadhyay on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/85650232/
